summary: This directory manages customer-related business logic and interface definitions. It provides centralized access to customer greeting creation functions and exports shared schema definitions required for consistent customer data handling across the application.
responsibilities: Expose domain-specific schema definitions for customer data
Provide a unified entry point for customer-related business logic
relationships: The customer greeting service relies on the shared schema definitions to structure data correctly.
The index file aggregates domain functionality and schema definitions to simplify imports for consumers.
designDecisions: Centralized export strategy to maintain a clean interface for external modules
Separation of business logic from underlying data schemas
